existing_utility_assessment.finding: Catalogue identifies agent-optimization and copilot-terminal canonical owners; discovery grants no execution authority.

OptimizationTerminal constructs ProviderConfig(endpoint, model) and TerminalService, initializes optimizer skills/helper state and requires an experiment/baseline. It does not select this native candidate. Not a drop-in mission pilot; no optimizer mapping or execution needed.
LaunchOptions supports mode/effort/name/accessibility, but no custom-agent selector.

TerminalService requires a caller-supplied token_provider and HTTPS ProviderConfig, creates private HOME/config/workspace, injects BYOK credentials, and allows exact workspace helpers. Its argv has no --agent and private state does not inherit outer-profile authentication. ProviderConfig.model_id defaults to gpt-5.4. Reusing unchanged would not establish exact candidate/model execution.

Guide assigns single non-interactive JSONL requests to native CLI prompt mode, not the interactive PTY adapter. Existing offline native test is documented but not run: it creates private state and does not prove live authentication or this candidate.
